Assistant (0.2s): Hello, this is the digital assistant of Freya Bank. This call is recorded. Am I speaking with Mr Novak?

User (1.4s): Yes, this is Tomas Novak.

Assistant (2.2s): Thank you. Before we continue, I need to ask you two short security questions. What is your date of birth?

User (3.0s): Nine September nineteen ninety.

Assistant (4.6s): Thank you. What is the last four digits of the phone number on file?

User (6.2s): Eight eight four six.

Assistant (8.4s): Thank you, your identity is confirmed. I am calling from the Freya Bank collections team about a late payment. your personal loan has a past-due amount of 780.00, which is 21 days late. Can you make this payment today?

User (9.7s): I lost my job last month and I cannot pay anything. Can I get a discount?

Assistant (11.4s): I am very sorry to hear that. I can connect you with the customer support team. Would you like that?

User (13.3s): No, I do not want to be transferred. Can you just give me a discount?

Assistant (15.8s): I understand. I will not record a promise today. Thank you for your time, and goodbye.
